name: Binance Spot Market Data API
summary: Keyless public market data from the Binance spot exchange: prices, order books, trades and candlesticks for all trading pairs.
description: The data-api.binance.vision host serves only the public market-data endpoints of the Binance Spot REST API: exchangeInfo, tickers, order book depth, recent and aggregate trades and klines (candlesticks). No account or key is needed. It is the same API surface as api.binance.com minus trading and account endpoints.

auth.notes: The market-data-only host needs no key; the docs list the endpoints available on it.

rate_limit.summary: exchangeInfo reports REQUEST_WEIGHT 6,000 per minute and RAW_REQUESTS 300,000 per 5 minutes per IP; each endpoint has a weight (response headers x-mbx-used-weight-1m show consumption).

endpoints.summary: Latest price for one or all symbols

license.name: Binance terms of use (not re-confirmed for data reuse)

coverage.geographic: Global crypto spot markets on Binance
coverage.temporal: Live data; klines history per symbol

agent_notes: Symbols are concatenated pairs like BTCUSDT. Numbers are strings; klines are arrays: [openTime, open, high, low, close, volume, closeTime, quoteVolume, trades, ...]. For long history use startTime/endTime paging or the bulk dumps at data.binance.vision. Use data-api.binance.vision rather than api.binance.com for read-only work.
caveats: Calling without a symbol on some endpoints returns every pair and carries a high request weight.
api.binance.com also answered 200 on /ping from the check host; the data-api host is the documented market-data-only alternative.
Weights vary per endpoint; check the x-mbx-used-weight-1m response header.

verification.notes: Example executed keyless. exchangeInfo, klines, depth and time also returned 200; CORS * on the example and on a second origin.
